form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES
form.official-title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to repay the estates of deceased beneficiaries for certain benefits paid by the Secretary and misused by fiduciaries of such beneficiaries.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Restoring Benefits to Defrauded Veterans Act.

section.header: Reissuance by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs of estates of deceased beneficiaries for certain benefits paid by the Secretary and misused by fiduciaries
section.text: Section 6107 of title 38, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating subsections (c) and (d) as subsections (d) and (e), respectively;
by inserting after subsection (b) the following new subsection (c):

subsection.header: Reissuance of amounts in the case of a deceased beneficiary

paragraph.text: If a beneficiary described in subsection (a) predeceases a payment under subsection (a) or (b), the Secretary shall pay such benefits, subject to paragraph (2), to an individual or entity in accordance with section 5121 of this title.
The Secretary may not make a payment under this subsection to a fiduciary who misused benefits of the beneficiary.
in subsection (e), as redesdignated, by striking subsection (a) or (b) and inserting this section.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 17, 2024.
